build_bleu_scorer: build a Scorer instance with BleuConfig to compute BLEU scores from torch.IntTensor references and predictions
add_reference_prediction_pairs: add reference and prediction token tensors to the Scorer using the add method for BLEU accumulation
compute_bleu_score: compute the final BLEU score by calling score on the Scorer with a specified n-gram order
create_sacrebleu_scorer: create a SacrebleuScorer with SacrebleuConfig to evaluate translations using sacrebleu corpus_bleu with custom tokenization
get_bleu_result_string: get a formatted BLEU result string with precision, brevity penalty, ratio, and lengths via result_string
